job.rawJd:
AI Business Partner
Boston - Massachusetts; Carmel - Indiana; Chicago - Illinois; Lambertville - New Jersey; Remote - USA
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

The AI Business Partner translates business priorities into practical AI solutions that improve how work gets done. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, domain expertise, and applied AI, this role identifies high-value opportunities, builds working prototypes and pilots, and partners cross-functionally to scale successful solutions.
This role is ideal for someone who can move fluidly from ambiguity to action — working with stakeholders to define problems, rapidly testing ideas using modern generative AI tools, and helping the organization adopt AI in ways that are useful, responsible, and aligned with business needs. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you’ll do:

AI Opportunity Identification & Prioritization

Identify high-value opportunities to apply generative AI across workflows, deliverables, and business processes.
Translate strategic priorities and business challenges into clearly scoped AI use cases, pilots, and solution concepts.
Assess opportunities based on business value, feasibility, user needs, adoption potential, and risk.
Partner with leaders and subject matter experts to prioritize initiatives that can drive meaningful efficiency, quality, or innovation gains.
Prototyping & Solution Development

Build and iterate on working prototypes, pilots, and lightweight AI-enabled tools using modern development environments, LLM APIs, agentic workflows, and related technologies.
Design prompts, workflows, and tool interactions that guide AI behavior toward accurate, useful, and contextually relevant outcomes.
Test solutions quickly, incorporate user feedback, and refine prototypes based on real-world usage and evolving requirements.
Move ideas from concept to demonstrable value, balancing speed, practicality, and quality.
Cross-Functional Delivery & Scaling

Partner closely with AI technical teams, engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transition validated prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions where appropriate.
Help define requirements, document learnings, and support handoffs that enable successful implementation and longer-term sustainability.
Work across technical and non-technical teams to align on priorities, solution design, success metrics, and rollout approach.
Use strong judgment to determine when to continue iterating independently and when to engage specialized technical partners.
Adoption, Enablement & Change Management

Support successful adoption of AI solutions by creating practical guidance, training, onboarding materials, and usage playbooks.
Communicate AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations in clear, accessible language for non-technical audiences.
Help build AI fluency across the organization by enabling teams to use tools responsibly and effectively in their day-to-day work.
Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and practical innovation.
Governance, Quality & Responsible AI

Help ensure AI solutions are designed and applied in ways that are responsible, compliant, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare communications environment.
Incorporate considerations related to privacy, safety, quality, transparency, and human oversight into solution design and rollout.
Partner with relevant stakeholders to align AI use with organizational standards, governance expectations, and evolving best practices.
Promote thoughtful experimentation while maintaining appropriate safeguards and quality controls. 
Domain Expertise Application

Apply strong understanding of healthcare communications, including advertising, activation, communications, and medical domains, to shape relevant and impactful AI solutions.
Ensure solutions reflect real-world workflows, stakeholder needs, and the nuances of regulated client environments.
Translate domain knowledge into practical requirements that improve usability, relevance, and business fit.
What you should have: 

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Data Science or related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience in a relevant field.
Experience in AI innovation, product, or a related area (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).
Experience in digital strategy, consulting, healthcare communications, or a related area (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).
Hands-on experience building, testing, and iterating on generative AI workflows, prototypes, copilots, agents, or similar solutions.
Familiarity Proficiency with LLM APIs, prompting strategies, AI-assisted development environments, and modern tools used to prototype AI-enabled workflows.
Strong ability to translate ambiguous business needs into practical, testable AI use cases and solution concepts.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical audiences. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences with the ability to translate technical concepts for a non-technical audience
Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and execution skills in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
Ability to evaluate solutions through the lens of usefulness, risk, quality, and business impact.
Skills and Competencies

Agentic Workflows; AI - Artificial Intelligence; Large Language Models (LLMs); Machine Learning
Coding; Programming Languages; Software Engineering
Product Demonstration; Technical Troubleshooting
Implementation Management; Solution Delivery; Solution Design
Client Relationship Management; Problem Analysis; Workflow Analysis
This position is crucial in driving the execution of AI strategies at Real Chemistry, ensuring that AI initiatives are not only innovative but also practical, effective, and aligned with real-world needs. The chosen candidate will play a pivotal role in enhancing the organization's capabilities and fostering a culture of AI-driven innovation and continuous improvement.

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI Business Partner role at Real Chemistry. The role's focus on useful AI fits the way I work. I start with a real business problem, build something people can test, and use their feedback to decide what should scale. My background combines healthcare communications, enterprise product leadership, client strategy, and current hands-on AI implementation.

At Hedgehox, I turn pharma agency workflows into AI tools for MLR claim review, brief intake, scoping, review routing, submission capture, and FDA signal monitoring. Claims Detector identifies promotional claims, surfaces evidence gaps, and prepares audit-ready annotations for human review before MLR submission. I built the functional POC, shaped the demo with investors, and secured an investor. I also built Scope Generator for agency finance and operations teams managing rate cards, brands, sub-brands, and natural-language scope changes.

Through One Block Away, I lead client discovery and turn unclear business questions into working POCs. ListingPal produces a listing campaign from basic property inputs in under 90 seconds. WeReady turns founder inputs, GitHub signals, source health, risk scoring, and evidence trails into a startup-readiness dashboard. I stay with each POC from product strategy and workflow design through a working demo and client iteration.

Earlier agency and enterprise work taught me how to bring technical and non-technical teams together. I spent eight years managing Fortune 500 pharma and healthcare clients, translating brand strategy into briefs, feedback, production requirements, timelines, and MLR-ready deliverables. At Kinesso, I helped grow a distributed product design team from 2 to 30 and led work for enterprise analytics used by more than 7,000 people across 22 brands. That experience still shapes how I explain technical choices, gather feedback, and design for adoption.
I would welcome the chance to discuss how this background could help Real Chemistry turn healthcare business needs into practical AI solutions that teams can use.
